#--------------------------------------------

# AVENIR-spatial-ate/analysis/08A-fig1-context_map.qmd
#
# Manuscript Figure 1: study area context map. A national map of Niger with
# the study region marked, plus a zoomed panel showing the grappes with their
# randomization arm. Presentation only - no model is attached and nothing is
# estimated here.
#
# Two layouts are written and both are kept; confirm which one the current
# manuscript draft uses before regenerating:
#   fig1-context-map-2.png     single panel - grappe map with the Niger inset
#   fig1-context-map-dosso.png two panels (A/B) - the same map plus the Dosso
#                              mortality panel, built as `alt_fig1`
#
# Inputs:  data/untouched/ner_admin_boundaries/ner_admin{1,2}.shp
#          data/grappe_mortality_data_all_rands.rds  (all randomizations, so
#                                                     Fig 1 shows the whole trial)
#          data/niger_adm2_sub.rds
# Outputs: results/manuscript/fig1-context-map-2.png
#          results/manuscript/fig1-context-map-dosso.png
#
#--------------------------------------------
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

rm(list = ls())
```

```{r Load packages and config}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

source(here::here("analysis", "0-config.R"))
```

```{r Load base maps}

# Load Niger boundaries map from Humanitarian Data Exchange
# Map downloaded from https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-ner on 10 March 2026

niger_adm1 <- st_read(dsn = here("data", "untouched", "ner_admin_boundaries", "ner_admin1.shp"))
niger_adm2 <- st_read(dsn = here("data", "untouched", "ner_admin_boundaries", "ner_admin2.shp"))

```

```{r Load data}

df_all <- readRDS(here("data","grappe_mortality_data_all_rands.rds"))
niger_adm2_sub <- readRDS(here("data", "niger_adm2_sub.rds"))

# Project coordinates to UTM so distances are in meters, not degrees

d_sf <- df_all %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = global_crs) %>%
  # st_transform(crs = proj_crs) %>% 
  mutate(lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,2])

```


```{r Prep data}

# filter admin level 2 subdistricts to just Dosso and Tahoua
niger_adm2 <- niger_adm2 %>%
    filter(adm1_name %in% c("Dosso","Tahoua"))

niger_dists_cr <- st_crop(niger_adm1, xmin = 0, xmax = 7,
                                    ymin = 11, ymax = 19)

niger_adm1 <- niger_adm1 %>%
  mutate(interest = ifelse(adm1_name %in% c("Dosso","Tahoua"), "Yes", "No"))

dosso_union <- niger_adm2 %>%
  filter(adm1_name == "Dosso") %>%
  st_union()

tahoua_union <- niger_adm2 %>%
  filter(adm1_name == "Tahoua") %>%
  st_union()
```

```{r Plot Niger departments map}

plot_niger_admin <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data=niger_adm1, aes(fill = interest), color="black",lwd=0.5) +
    # geom_sf(data=niger_gadm0_sf, color="black",lwd=0.5) +
    coord_sf(crs = global_crs) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = 2, xmax = 7, ymin = 11.5, ymax = 19), color = "black", fill = NA, lty = "dashed", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    # add country labels
    annotate("text",x=16,y=11, label = "Niger", fontface="bold",size=6, hjust = 1, vjust = 0) +
    labs(x="",y="") +
    ylim(c(11, 23)) +
  xlim(c(0, 16)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0, "pt")
        ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "grey70", "No" = "grey90"), guide = "none")

plot_niger_admin

```

```{r Plot grappes map}

# annotation line
dosso_lab_line <- data.frame(x1=3.25,x2=3.4,y1=14.35,y2=13.9)
tahoua_lab_line <-  data.frame(x1=5.9,x2=5.5,y1=17.9,y2=17.5)

# detailed zoom view, including grappes
plot_grappe_map <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data=niger_adm2, fill="white", color="black",lwd=0.3) +
    # admin boundaries
    geom_sf(data=dosso_union, fill=NA, color="black",lwd=1) +
    geom_sf(data=tahoua_union, fill=NA, color="black",lwd=1) +
    # cluster points
    geom_sf(data=d_sf, aes(color=adaptive_rand),size=0.1, alpha=0.9, pch=19) +
    coord_sf(crs = global_crs,
             xlim = c(2.3, 7.4), ylim = c(11.4, 18.9),
             expand = FALSE) +
    # scale_shape_manual(values=c(15,16,17)) +
    # scale_color_brewer(type="seq") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("#FFA400FF", "grey40", "grey70"),
                             breaks = c("Randomization 1", "Randomization 2", "Randomization 3"),
                             labels = c("24 months", "12 months", "6 months"),
                             name = "\nFollow-up time") +
    # admin labels
    annotate("text",x=6,y=18.2, label = "Tahoua", fontface = "bold", color = "gray80", size=8) + # x=5.2,y=16.2,
    annotate("text",x=3.15,y=14.65, label = "Dosso", fontface = "bold", color = "gray80", size=8,
             vjust = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(data=dosso_lab_line, aes(x=x1, xend=x2, y=y1, yend=y2), color = "gray80", lwd=0.8, arrow=arrow(angle=30,length=unit(2,"mm"),ends="last",type="open")) +
    geom_segment(data=tahoua_lab_line, aes(x=x1, xend=x2, y=y1, yend=y2), color = "gray80", lwd=0.8, arrow=arrow(angle=30,length=unit(2,"mm"),ends="last",type="open"))  +
    annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.3, pad_y=unit(0.1,"cm")) +
    annotation_north_arrow(location = "bl", which_north = "true", 
        pad_x = unit(0.05, "in"), pad_y = unit(0.2, "in"),
        height=unit(0.75,"cm"), width=unit(0.75,"cm"),
        style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering
        ) +
    labs(x="Longitude",y="Latitude") +
    guides(color=guide_legend(reverse = FALSE, override.aes = list(size=4), direction = "vertical", nrow = 1))  +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12)
    )

plot_grappe_map


```

```{r Plot map with inset}  

plot_map_with_inset <- plot_grappe_map + 
    inset_element(plot_niger_admin,
                  left = unit(0.42, "npc"), top = unit(0.4, "npc"),
                  bottom = unit(0, "npc"), right = unit(0.74, "npc"),
                  ignore_tag = TRUE,
                  on_top = TRUE
    )

# see patch for existing bug in patchwork for geom_sf
# https://stackoverflow.com/questions/18252827/increasing-area-around-plot-area-in-ggplot2
plot_map_with_inset$patches$layout$widths  <- 1
plot_map_with_inset$patches$layout$heights <- 1

plot_map_with_inset

ggsave(here("results", "manuscript", "fig1-context-map-2.png"),
       plot_map_with_inset,
       device = "png",
       width = 175,
       height = 160,
       units = "mm",
       dpi = 300,
       bg = "white")
```

```{r}

niger_adm2 <- niger_adm2 %>%
  filter(adm1_name == "Dosso") %>%
  st_make_valid()

district_labels <- tibble::tibble(
  district = c("Boboye", "Loga", "Dogondoutchi", "Dosso",
               "Tibiri", "Falmey", "Dioundiou", "Gaya"),
  lon      = c(2.78, 3.45, 4.10, 3.30,
               3.92, 2.65, 4, 3.45),
  lat      = c(13.05, 13.66, 13.90, 12.90,
               13.10, 12.30, 12.50, 12.10)
)

dioundiou_lab_line <- data.frame(x1 = 3.58, x2 = 3.7, y1 = 12.60, y2 = 12.50)
falmey_lab_line <- data.frame(x1 = 2.85, x2 = 2.65, y1 = 12.55, y2 = 12.37)

dosso_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2, color = "NA", size = 0.25, fill = "white") +
  # geom_sf(data = subset(d_sf, region == "Dosso"), aes(color = adaptive_rand), size = 0.3, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2, color = "black", size = 0.15, fill = "NA") +
  geom_sf(data = dosso_union, color = "black", size = 0.5, fill = "NA") +
  geom_text(data = district_labels, aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = district), size = 3, color = "black")+
  # scale_colour_manual(values = c("#FFA400FF", "grey40", "grey70"),
  #                            breaks = c("Randomization 1", "Randomization 2", "Randomization 3"),
  #                            labels = c("24 months", "12 months", "6 months"),
  #                            name = "Follow-up time") +
  # scale_color_manual(breaks = c("Infant Azithro", "Placebo", "Child Azithro"),
  #                    labels = c("**Control**: Infant Azithro", "**Control**: Placebo", "**Treatment**"),
  #                    values = c("#DA9FB8FF", "#C1447EFF", "#6E8537FF")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.5, y = 14.5, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, fontface = "bold", label = "Dosso\nregion") +
  annotation_scale() +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "bl", which_north = "true", 
                         pad_x = unit(0.05, "in"), pad_y = unit(0.2, "in"),
                         height=unit(0.75,"cm"), width=unit(0.75,"cm"),
                         style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering) +
  geom_segment(data = dioundiou_lab_line, aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y1, yend = y2), color = "gray20", lwd=0.2) +
  geom_segment(data = falmey_lab_line, aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y1, yend = y2), color = "gray20", lwd=0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Longitude") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Latitude") +
  # theme(
  #   legend.position = "bottom",
  #   legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
  #   legend.title = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
  #   legend.text = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)
  # ) +
  guides(color = "none")

dosso_map

```

```{r Plot final figure with inset}

design <- "
142
143
"

alt_fig1 <- plot_grappe_map + 
    inset_element(plot_niger_admin,
                  left = unit(30, "mm"), top = unit(33, "mm"),
                  bottom = unit(2, "mm"), right = unit(87, "mm"),
                  ignore_tag = TRUE,
                  on_top = TRUE
    ) +
  dosso_map + guide_area() + plot_spacer() +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.1, -0.2, 1),
              heights = c(1, 0.15),
              guides = "collect",
              axes = "collect",
              design = design) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A", tag_suffix = ")")

alt_fig1

ggsave(paste0(manuscript_figs_path, "fig1-context-map-dosso.png"),
       alt_fig1,
       device = "png",
       width = 210,
       height = 140,
       units = "mm",
       dpi = 300,
       bg = "white",
       create.dir = TRUE)

```
